WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_avg_bw
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg_bw
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT 
  sa.observstation,
  sa.station_avg_bw,
  sa.station_avg_bw - oa.overall_avg_bw as difference
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.station_avg_bw > oa.overall_avg_bw
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
